name: superwall
about: Superwall paywall editor (web-view renderer, authored through property panels, per-element Custom CSS and write_html). See KIT.md.

css.why: no grid layout; stacks are flexbox
no @keyframes; motion is Lottie, GIF or video
clip-path is undocumented; use radius + overflow or an image
masks are undocumented; use radius + overflow or an image
masks are undocumented; use radius + overflow or an image
pictures are image nodes (in a layered stack), not CSS backgrounds
line clamping is undocumented; size the copy to fit
the editor's stacks ignore flex-grow; use fixed or % sizes and stack distribution

literal.why: a price typed as text; bind it to a product variable
a date typed as text; compute it with Liquid (trialPeriodEndDate, date_add)
